name: @blueshed/railroad
description: The smallest reactive layer for Bun realtime apps — signals, JSX, hash router. Built so an LLM can use it correctly without re-learning. Pair with @blueshed/delta for WebSocket document sync.

scripts.check:consumer: bun check -p tests/consumer-types/tsconfig.json && bun check -p tests/consumer-types/tsconfig.react.json && bun check -p tests/fixtures/readme/tsconfig.server.json
scripts.test:examples: bun check -p examples/jobs/tsconfig.json && cd examples/jobs && bun test
scripts.test:fast: bun check && bun test --path-ignore-patterns="tests/webview*.test.ts" && bun run test:examples
scripts.test:slow: bun run check:consumer && bun run test:webview

author: Peter Bunyan <peter@blueshed.co.uk> (https://blueshed.co.uk)
